QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Lingering Suspicions
QuestInfo.0: J is back from his investigation of the Castle. Talk to #bJ#k in #b#m211060800##k.
QuestInfo.1:
Von Leon the Lion King became the Black Mage's Commander to take revenge on the coalition after he lost his kingdom because of them. However, theres still a lot of uncertainty around the coalition. Maybe they were also controlled by someone to attack the kingdom.

But regardless of how it happened, there was only way it could end... #bdefeating the Black Mage#k.
